articles.title: Hen - Official Trailer - IGN
articles.summary:
Check out the trailer for Hen, an upcoming film starring Ioannis Kokiasmenos, Maria Diakopanagioti, Argyris Pantazaras, Eleni Apostolopoulou, Mahmod Bamerny, Antonis Tsiotsiopoulos, and Antonis Kafetzopoulos. The Hen is played by Eszti, Szandi, Feri, Enci, Eti, Enikő, Nóra, and Anett.Hen chronicles a remarkable chicken as she escapes her grisly fate in this unorthodox and bold story from director György Pálfi and executive producer Ari Aster, telling a tall tale of human misery via a small bird in search of home.

Hen is written by György Pálfi and Ruttkay Zsófia. Hen opens at the Quad Cinema in New York on November 6, 2026.

articles.title: Lostbound - Official Release Date Trailer - IGN
articles.summary: Take a look at gameplay and more from Lostbound in this latest trailer for the upcoming dark roguelite action RPG, where the world itself disappears behind you. Lostbound will be available on PC via Steam on October 6, 2026. A demo is out now on Steam.In Lostbound, exploration comes with a unique risk. The more players move through the world, the more it begins to crumble in their wake, with previously explored paths disappearing as The Hand advances.Players must constantly decide where to go next, balancing exploration against the need to stay ahead of their relentless pursuer. Push too far and risk losing the route home, or turn back while there's still a way out.
